scope: Mixed CPU/GPU supervisor continuation lowering now consumes shared placement-aware typed IR instead of walking source expressions.

semantics.resolution: TypedStatement and SymbolId bindings; checked FunctionId maps independently to CPU export IDs, including main-first source order.
semantics.values: Path-local ValueId emission cache reuses dominating graph values; scopes/conditional arms restore their environments.
semantics.control_flow: Typed parallel/catch/match/error-field/fail/await/try nodes retain resumable settlement and error boundaries.
semantics.residency: Targets and transfers use checked IR. Error rethrow placeholders preserve success-type GPU residence without implicit data movement.
semantics.shapes: ShapeCheck nodes operate only on successful completed values; checked constant shapes and exact literal bits feed existing bridge.
semantics.evaluation: CPU arguments precede target selection and admission. Match fields reuse the already evaluated subject.
semantics.pipelines: Mixed main uses resolved FunctionCall IR for ordinary CPU pipelines.
semantics.remaining: C++ target continuation backend remains distinct from ordinary CPU task planner. Signature capability checks and CPU export construction still use source interfaces; asynchronous helper bodies and broader values are not introduced.

coverage: GPU tensor result rethrow and recovery
typed error pattern fields and nested match
source_fixture.compiler_instrumentation: ASan/UBSan compiler emits identical host.cpp, cpu.ll, kernel0.mlir, placement.ir and manifest.txt to normal compiler.

diagnostics: Negative cases now assert shared semantic categories; float32 context added where an unconstrained numeric binding masked the intended invalid task/binding check. Output sentinel checks retained.

changed_cpu_lowering.reason: The shared checker folds tensor unary plus to its operand, eliminating the old redundant host pos wrapper and shifting subsequent generated wrapper IDs in host-expression fixtures.

distributed_execution: Not implemented; design-review gate retained in docs/roadmap.md.
performance: Compiler architecture and correctness integration; no speedup claim.
